# meeting-minutes

> Turn meeting transcripts into validated minutes with a summary, decisions and action items with owner and due date, through an LLM port. Python package `trysac-meeting-minutes`, import name `meeting_minutes`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, public API summary
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions, limits
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and its public API
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model, prompt-injection defences and limits
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run the tests and what they cover
